source_reference.paper_title: Low functional diversity promotes niche changes in natural island pollinator communities
source_reference.target_source_locator: electronic supplementary material Table S2; Table S4 for the five taxa with explicitly reported site-specific numeric values
source_reference.paper_measurement_protocol: At each site, five pollinator individuals per species, or all individuals when fewer than five were available, were measured with digital calipers; mean proboscis length was calculated per species x site.

next_recovery_order: retain the seven current and nine 2017 unmatched taxa as unresolved unless source identity is established without fuzzy matching
recover plant x pollinator interaction weights if lawful Dryad bytes become available, or collect prospective plant-specific visitor weights
measure missing visitor proboscis directly when a site-exact FDQ or plant-specific center is required
keep the community-center signed-position result separate from a plant-specific partner-center claim
use prospective SVD and reproductive-dependency data for the next causal propagation gate
claim_boundary: Source-native species-level numeric proboscis values are now recovered for 202/209 current named taxa, but this does not make all site-specific proboscis values exact and does not open exact plant-specific FDQ reconstruction. The frozen community-center signed-position projection is a separate same-network transfer estimand; no functional-bin, family, guild, body-size or fuzzy-match values are inserted.
